resolution: Factual follow-up: how much GPU memory the foliage preview actually occupies. Tallied from framework/gpu/3d.zig buffer creations: the preview's five families reserve ~15.5 MiB VRAM (655,360 slim rows x 24 B + 16,384 trunk rows x 32 B) inside a 24 MiB slim static pool; the renderer's entire fixed GPU footprint is ~360 MiB (256 MiB retained geometry pool at the WebGPU default 256 MiB maxBufferSize, 32 MiB static instance pool, 24 MiB slim pool, ~30 MiB per-frame staging, 16 MiB shadow map). On an 8-24 GB GPU the contested budget is ~0.2% of VRAM; the 256 MiB per-buffer ceiling is a WebGPU DEFAULT raisable at device creation. Reported to the user; strengthens the pending elastic-pool ruling from req_2839. No code changed.
